title: The Metro, The Mall, and The Nerves
description: I still remember the walk toward Baiyappanahalli Metro station, feeling a kind of nervous I’d never felt before. We were both so scared, acting like we were on a secret mission instead of a date. It’s funny how a simple place like a Metro station can become a landmark in your heart just because that’s where you were waiting for her. We ended up at Gopalan Mall, just chilling, talking, and letting the hours slip away. There wasn't any grand plan—just us, a mall, and the beginning of something I didn't want to end. Sometimes I think back to that version of us and smile. We were so young, so cautious, and so blissfully unaware of how much that one afternoon would mean to me today. Those exact moments might stay in the past, but the happiness they gave me is something I carry every single day. Where 'Hello' turned into 'Forever' near Platform 1 (Purple Line).
